info.name: Learning
info.summary: Spaced Repetition Learning with Leitner System
info.description:
**Learning** is a powerful flashcard and quiz app for Nextcloud with a built-in Leitner 5-box spaced repetition system.
Create question pools, share them with your team, and study efficiently using scientifically-proven spaced repetition.
## Learning Modes
- **Smart Queue** — One-click "Jetzt Lernen" button reviews all due cards across every pool, prioritized by urgency - **Leitner Spaced Repetition** — 5-box system with automatic scheduling (1d, 3d, 7d, 14d intervals) - **Training Mode** — Quick quiz sessions with immediate feedback and score tracking - **Exam Mode** — Timed exams with configurable question count and animated snake timer - **Wahr/Falsch Mode** — Touch-friendly swipe-based true/false flashcard review - **Trouble Spots** — Focused practice on your hardest questions (3+ wrong, <30% accuracy) - **Daily Challenge** — One question per day with bonus XP reward for correct answers
## Question Types
- **Multiple Choice** — Questions with 2-8 answers, explanations, difficulty levels, multi-select support - **Free Text** — Open-ended questions with fuzzy answer matching (case-insensitive, typo-tolerant via Levenshtein distance) - **AI Question Generator** — Paste text (lecture notes, textbook excerpts), let AI generate questions with editable preview before import
## Gamification
- **XP & Levels** — Experience points from sessions, reviews, accuracy bonuses - **14 Badges** — Achievements across 6 categories (sessions, performance, mastery, streak, social, fun) - **XP Streak Multipliers** — Tier-based XP bonuses: 1.5x at 3-day streak, 2x at 7-day, 3x at 30-day - **Daily Goal** — Configurable daily review target with visual progress ring and XP bonus - **Level-Up Celebration** — Animated overlay when reaching a new level
## Course Management
- **Courses** — Instructors create courses, assign pools, enroll students - **Leaderboard** — Ranked by XP with medal indicators and student detail drill-down - **Student Progress** — Per-student XP, badges, streak, Leitner boxes per pool, session history - **At-Risk Warning** — Instructors see which students are falling behind with risk scores and reasons - **Role-Based UX** — Students start at Courses, instructors at Pools. Each feature has a dismissible explanation hint
## Data & Sharing
- **CSV/JSON Import** — Bulk import questions from CSV or JSON files - **CSV/JSON Export** — Export question pools for backup or sharing, roundtrip-compatible with import - **Pool Sharing** — Share pools with other users (read or edit permissions) - **Multi-Language Support** — Translate questions and answers into any language - **Search** — Full-text search across all your question pools
## Integration
- **Dashboard Widget** — See due questions at a glance from the Nextcloud Dashboard - **Activity Integration** — Badge unlocks appear in Nextcloud Activity stream - **Progress Tracking** — Stats, accuracy, mastery percentage per pool - **Mobile Optimized** — Touch-friendly responsive design
## Use Cases
- Employee Onboarding & Compliance Training - IT Certification Prep (CompTIA, Cisco, AWS) - University Courses & Exam Preparation - Language Learning Vocabulary - General Knowledge Retention
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 29, 30, or 31 - PHP 8.1+ - PostgreSQL 13+ or MySQL 8+
